The '''Coolant Overflow''', so named for the excess coolant dumped in the area, was a sector of [[Network Access]], part of the [[Network Security District]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:NA" /> The [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] maintained a [[Hutt data center|datacenter]] in the area.<ref name="TOR:WtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coolant Overflow appears as part of Network Access on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR:NA" />
